notes.title: Patch Notes (Sept. 5th, 2018)
notes.content:
A new patch has been deployed today with the following fixes/changes:

- Fixed an issue where the game may crash when connected to a high refresh rate monitor.

- There were instances where the game did not function correctly when connected to a high refresh rate monitor that offers numerous resolution options.  This has now been addressed.

This patch should improve or eliminate stability or launch issues that were dependent on the connected display device.

notes.title: Mega Man X Legacy Collection 1 + 2 Patch Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there fellow Maverick Hunters,

A new patch has been made available for [i]Mega Man X Legacy Collection[/i] and [i]Mega Man X Legacy Collection 2[/i] which provides the following updates:

[list]
[*]To address the screen blackout that affected some users when launching the game, the game now checks the resolution of the connected display device and supported resolutions and sets the appropriate output resolution accordingly
[*]Added V-Sync ON/OFF toggle. This option can be found under Options > Graphics > V-Sync. Turning off V-Sync may help increase performance if users experience framerate issues
[/list]

Thanks again for your patience and support and enjoy!

Best Regards,

Capcom USA Customer Support
